description:
Analysis and reporting source code, software-environment records, and group-level imaging and behavioral summaries for an interleaved dual-structure serial reaction time fMRI study of motor statistical learning and gradual sequence updating.

Version 1.1.0 adds results for 22 participants. The uncensored reference model with at least 80% observed regional support is primary. The learner-selected 20-participant subsample and motion-censored models are sensitivity analyses; the subsample appears only in the supplement. The samples overlap. The analyses were not preregistered, and the reporting model was chosen after earlier analyses; see the article Methods. Earlier 20-participant products from version 1.0.0 are retained unchanged.

The release includes group summaries, figures, source-file coverage, dictionaries, checksums and aggregate-verification instructions. Participant-level inputs, fitted models and values recoverable by leave-one-out arithmetic are withheld. Seven scripts containing individual observations are also withheld. Estimates from fewer than two participants are blank. Subject labels and filesystem paths in code refer to restricted inputs. The article table-generation script is included for reference and requires restricted inputs. Full model re-estimation requires approved data access and separate software and atlas resources.
